text: There is a deep hole on the road outside my house
gaddhe ki wajah se scooter gir gaya
amchya galli madhe khadde padle aahet
pothole at the signal, cars swerving suddenly
road par khadda hai, raat ko dikhta nahi
The tar road is broken into pieces near the hospital
road ki halat kharab hai, patthar nikal aaye
rastyachi dambar nighun geli aahe
cracks all over the road surface
rasta tutla aahe, durusti kara
Garbage not lifted from the corner of our street
kachra pada hai aur koi uthata nahi
ithe kachra takla jato, ghan vas yeto
overflowing garbage container near the hospital
plastic kachra rastyavar pasarla aahe
Rainwater collected in front of the shops
baarish me pura road paani me doob gaya
pavsat rasta talyasarkha hoto
street flooded, water entering ground floor homes
paani sachlyamule chalta yet nahi
Pipe under the road leaking clean water
nal ka pipe toota hai, paani beh raha hai
panyachi line futli aahe ani paani vaya jaat aahe
leaking water main near the temple
valve kharab aahe, paani galat aahe
Sewer is choked and overflowing near the shop
naali me kachra phasa hai, paani ruk gaya
gatar tumbali aahe ani durgandhi yete
drain blocked with plastic bags
manhole overflow hot aahe
The lamp post outside our building is dead
raat ko light nahi jalti
rastyavarcha diva band padla aahe
street lights flickering the whole night
khambavarchi light chalu nahi
Monkeys are entering houses in our colony
dukaan walon ne road par saaman rakha hai
zad padle aahe, vahtuk band aahe
loud speakers playing late at night
park madhe zopala tutla aahe
